description: This file contains unit tests for database-backed asset validation and integrity constraints in a backend system. It tests scenarios such as uniqueness of EU IDs, attribute mapping constraints, and hierarchy cycle detection.

classes.name: DbBackedUniquenessAndHierarchyIntegrityTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying database-backed asset constraints such as ID uniqueness and hierarchy integrity.

methods.name: Create_asset_with_duplicate_permit_eu_id_returns_409
methods.description: Tests that creating an asset with a duplicate permit EU ID returns HTTP 409 Conflict.

methods.name: Update_asset_to_duplicate_permit_eu_id_returns_409
methods.description: Tests that updating an asset to have a permit EU ID that duplicates another asset's ID returns HTTP 409 Conflict.

methods.name: Reporting_attribute_mapping_duplicate_combination_for_same_asset_returns_400
methods.description: Ensures that duplicate reporting attribute mappings for the same asset result in a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: Hierarchy_integrity_rejects_self_parent_and_cycles_400
methods.description: Verifies that an asset cannot be its own parent and detects cycles in the hierarchy, returning 400 Bad Request.
